headline: Uzbekistan and Oman agree on $5 billion joint investment project portfolio
summary: Uzbekistan and Oman formed a $5 billion portfolio of joint investment projects across industry, logistics, tourism, mineral resources, and technology, targeting bilateral trade of $1 billion.
why: Gulf sovereign wealth and private capital are expanding direct exposure in Central Asian infrastructure and resource sectors.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: A $5 billion joint investment portfolio supports industrial and logistics project funding.
